description: When a herdr-core Agent ends a turn and when that reads as Done on one device (ADR 0033), for the app's HerdrCoreTurnState and the Helper. kind is the Agent's kind under the Agent rule (herdr-core-agent-rule-v1.json), and doneReporters are the kinds known to report done. Steps run in order from no memory of the Terminal. A step's event is `snapshot` (a subscribe or missed record's turn, state and reported), `status` (a status event, state null for a cleared one), `turn` (a turn event: the core sends it after the status event that moved the count), `restarted` (a kept restart's record), `agent` (the Agent rule's answer changed: kind, null for no Agent) or `seen` (this device opened the Agent, or has it open). ends says whether the step ended a turn, and done whether the Agent reads Done afterwards.
provisionalReason: Built from the versioned compatibility observations and ADR 0033's cases; recordings of real harnesses on hc-lab may add cases.
